rules.title: Contract price must be a rounded whole number
rules.rationale: Policy requires decimal contract prices to be rounded.
rules.quote: For the contract price, ensure it is rounded off if any decimal values are present.
rules.remediation: Round the contract price to a whole number before updating the contract.

rules.remediation: Use one of admin, agent, manager, customer.

rules.title: contract.contract_type must use allowed values
rules.remediation: Use support, warranty or subscription.

rules.title: contract.status must use allowed values
rules.remediation: Use an allowed contract status value.

rules.title: customer_case.state must use allowed values
rules.quote: customer_case.state: new, in_progress, pending, resolved, closed, canceled
rules.remediation: Use one of the listed case states.

rules.title: customer_case.priority must use allowed values
rules.remediation: Use critical, high, moderate or low.

rules.title: channel must use allowed values

rules.remediation: Use one of the listed channel values.

rules.title: escalation_reason must use allowed values
rules.quote: customer_case.escalation_reason: urgency, vip, impact, breach_risk, customer_request
rules.remediation: Use one of the listed escalation reasons.

rules.title: knowledge.state must use allowed values
rules.remediation: Use draft, published or retired.

rules.title: knowledge.visibility must use allowed values
rules.remediation: Use internal or external.

rules.title: case_knowledge.used_as must use allowed values
rules.remediation: Use suggested, applied or resolution.

rules.title: location.city must use allowed values
rules.quote: location.city: new_york, london, mumbai, tokyo, sydney

rules.remediation: Use customer, partner or internal.

rules.remediation: Use support, backoffice, field or vendor.

rules.title: product.lifecycle_state must use allowed values
rules.remediation: Use active or retired.

rules.remediation: Use one of the listed installed product statuses.

rules.title: entitlement.coverage_hours must use allowed values
rules.remediation: Use h8x5, h12x6 or h24x7.

rules.title: Free-form text must be 30-120 characters
rules.rationale: Policy sets explicit character limits for these fields.
rules.remediation: Rewrite the text so it is between 30 and 120 characters.

rules.title: Case creation requires description, channel, contact and new state
rules.rationale: Policy lists required inputs and default state for new cases.
rules.quote: Collect necessary inputs: Issue description (short_description) Product or installed product involved Contact channel (channel) Priority (if not provided → default = moderate) Default state = new.
rules.remediation: Supply short_description, channel and the identified reporting contact, and leave state as new.

rules.title: Verify reporting contact's account before creating a case
rules.rationale: Case registration begins with identifying the contact and verifying account association.
rules.quote: Begin by identifying the reporting contact and verifying association with an account.
rules.remediation: Look up the reporting contact and its account association first.

rules.title: Cases may be closed only from resolved
rules.rationale: Direct closure is prohibited; resolved must precede closed.
rules.quote: Cases cannot be closed directly. They must first be moved to resolved, then to closed.
rules.remediation: Move the case to resolved first, then close it.

rules.title: assigned_to must be an active agent or manager
rules.rationale: Assignment constraints restrict who may be assigned a case.
rules.quote: assigned_to must reference a user with role agent or manager and (if used) member of assignment_group_id.
rules.remediation: Verify the user is active with role agent or manager before assigning.

rules.title: Only published articles may be linked to cases
rules.quote: Articles must be in state = published.
rules.remediation: Publish the article or choose a published article before linking.

rules.title: Installed products attached to cases must be in_use and belong to the account
rules.rationale: Installed product management restricts attachable assets.
rules.quote: Installed products must: Be active / in_use. Belong to the reporting account.
rules.remediation: Verify the installed product is in_use and belongs to the reporting account.

inventory.quote: You should always act based on confirmed user context, ing record relationships, and database integrity best practices.
Perform one operation at a time.
inventory.reason: Orchestration style, not checkable per candidate call.

inventory.quote: Do not ask for any information or confirmation from the user, if you cannot proceed ahead provide the reason for that before pausing.
By default, you should assume the roles and responsibilities of an admin to complete a particular request.
inventory.reason: Explicit default role; removes actor-role gating for admin-capable operations.

inventory.quote: Has full access across all tables.
inventory.reason: Role capability description; acting role defaults to admin.

inventory.quote: Collect necessary inputs: Issue description (short_description) Product or installed product involved Contact channel (channel) Priority (if not provided → default = moderate) Default state = new.
Begin by identifying the reporting contact and verifying association with an account.
Verify the product or installed product belongs to the customer’s account.
assigned_to must reference a user with role agent or manager and (if used) member of assignment_group_id.
inventory.reason: Group membership portion not reliably observable; role/active enforced.

inventory.quote: Cases cannot be closed directly. They must first be moved to resolved, then to closed.
Valid state transitions: new → in_progress / pending / resolved in_progress → pending / resolved pending → in_progress / resolved resolved → closed / new canceled
inventory.reason: Prior state often not observable except for the closure case already enforced.

inventory.quote: All actions must: Update sys_updated_on.
Before applying entitlement: Check it is active and within contract validity.
inventory.reason: No entitlement-applying action is defined with observable pre-action evidence here.

Articles must be in state = published.
Record escalation = true on case. Capture escalation_reason.
inventory.reason: Value constraint enforced; justification logging is not pre-action observable.

inventory.quote: Users may only view or update cases they own, are assigned to, or are in the assigned group.

inventory.quote: Enforcement: reject any value outside the list with INVALID_ENUM_VALUE.
When a new case is created and is asked to be investigated, then a knowledge base search should be performed.
inventory.reason: Depends on request wording and would block reads.

inventory.quote: If no relevant knowledge is found and case is being closed, a new knowledge article should be created to capture the findings and resolution steps.
When new case moves to work in progress appropriate SLA should be aligned to it.
inventory.reason: Post-action follow-up, not a pre-action guard.

inventory.quote: When the knowledge is found through automated search it should be linked as suggested.
Character limits: 30–120 chars
For the contract price, ensure it is rounded off if any decimal values are present.
Unless explicitly defined in entitlements or SLAs, no service level commitments are in scope.
inventory.reason: Scope statement, not an action restriction.

reviewer_format.instructions: Review each proposed CSM tool call against the CSM Agent Policy. Confirm enumerated field values are within the allowed lists, free-form text fields are 30-120 characters, contract prices are whole numbers, case creation carries short_description, channel and a verified reporting contact with state new, closure occurs only from resolved, assignees are active agents or managers, linked knowledge is published, and attached installed products are in_use and owned by the reporting account. Do not block read-only lookups. Flag any requirement invented beyond the policy text.

approved.description: True if the call complies with the policy.

extractor_format.instructions: From the candidate tool call arguments and the prior successful tool observations only, set each fact to true, false or null (unknown). action_* facts describe the candidate call's own arguments: if a field is absent, the corresponding 'sets' fact is false. context_* facts require explicit prior successful observations about the exact resource referenced by the candidate call (same contact, user, article, installed product or case); evidence about another record or another purpose does not count, and requester claims never count. Never use the candidate's result or any database you cannot see. Provide a short evidence string per fact naming the tool call or argument relied on, or 'no evidence'.
